resources.string: Turn this phone or tablet into a monitoring display for your computer.
How do you want to connect?
Computers on the same network as this phone
Plug the phone into the computer
From My Displays › Add Android on the computer
When the computer is not found automatically
No computer answered. Check that both are on the same network and that \"Connect over the network\" is on in Big Screen Monitor Display (My Displays).

1. On the computer, open Big Screen Monitor Display › My Displays and press "Add Android…".

2. Point this phone's camera at the code (or tap "Scan the code"), or choose the computer below and allow it there when both show the same code.

3. The phone shows the theme. Swipe sideways to change theme, hold for the menu, tap for the controls. Two fingers open this app's own menu.

4. Away from home: with Tailscale (or another VPN) on the phone and on the computer, connect once at home. The app learns the computer's VPN address and reaches it from anywhere; or add the computer by its Tailscale address (100.x.y.z).

Nothing on the computer is controlled from the phone except this display: no mouse, no keyboard.

With the phone paired once (over the network or with the code), plug it into the computer: the computer asks it to open this app as a USB accessory. Android asks for permission the first time — tick "Always" to make it a permanent display.

Other ways that also work:
• USB tethering (Settings › Network › Hotspot › USB tethering): then add the computer normally.
• USB debugging (developers): "adb reverse tcp:7717 tcp:7717" and connect to 127.0.0.1.
On the computer: My Displays › Add Android. Point this phone\'s camera at the code and open the link it shows; this app opens and pairs by itself. No camera permission is needed by this app.
Type an IP address or name, optionally with :port.
Forget %1$s? To use it again you will have to add it again.
On the computer (My Displays), allow this phone only if it shows the same code:
Connected. Waiting for the first picture…
The connection to the computer was lost.
The code expired. Show a new one on the computer.
The computer did not accept this phone\'s key. Pair again.
This phone is no longer paired with the computer. Pair again.
The pairing was removed on the computer.
This display is switched off on the computer (My Displays › Use this display).
This phone connected again in another way (for example USB).
The computer\'s identity changed. For your safety the app does not connect. If the computer was reinstalled, forget it and add it again.
The codes did not match: something is between this phone and the computer. Nothing was paired.
A different computer answered at this address.
The computer sent something this app does not understand. Update the app or the computer.
The computer is busy with other requests. Try again in a moment.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
The monitoring service on the computer stopped.
This app and the computer speak different versions. Update both.
Picture of the computer\'s monitoring theme
Open the last computer when the app starts and reconnect after losing it (permanent display)
Hide the status and navigation bars
Only the theme: the menu button never appears (two fingers still open the menu)
While the theme is shown (permanent display)
Moves the picture a few pixels from time to time
Let the computer set this screen\'s brightness (only in this app)
Swipe to change theme, hold for the menu
Play, pause, next and volume on the Big Media Player
These options are saved on the computer for this display.
Connect to a computer to change these options.
